The repository also includes a FastAPI API over the same artefacts and a PostgreSQL/PostGIS schema with Docker Compose as the target architecture. Nothing you do in the interface is sent to a server.

The most important result is methodological: with strict chronological validation, the machine-learning models improve little on historical frequency, and for large events they do not improve on it. The platform shows this as it is.
